newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Four ships distressed by Bangladesh cyclone.
newsitem.headline: Four ships distressed by Bangladesh cyclone.

text.p: Panamanian flag ship Esco Argo sent an SOS message to storm-battered Chittagong port on Monday night, saying that it was sinking in the Bay of Bengal near Kutubdia island, port officials said.

They said the ship, which arrived in Chittagong on Sunday from Bangkok carrying 3,235 tonnes of cement, was sent to the outer anchorage for safety before the cyclone struck at 200 kph (124 mph) on Monday afternoon.
"Now we have got an SOS from the Esco Argo that it is sinking," one port official said.
He said Bangladeshi lighter vessel "Pioneer" and survey vessel "Anusandhani" might have also sunk. "This has yet to be confirmed," the official said.
Another Bangladeshi freighter, Q.C. Teal, broke anchor and was drifting at sea, the official told reporters without giving details.
The cyclone killed five people and left hundreds injured, officials said quoting early reports. The extent of losses could be much higher when full reports would be available, he added.
